name: the-docket
description: The Docket: a ledger of rulings that governs a codebase, with a judge that reads every stop against the rulings and blocks one that breaks a ruling, and, as its first half, a hook that prints what governs a region before an edit.

plugins.name: the-docket
plugins.description: A ledger of rulings that governs a codebase. At stop: a judge reads the diff against the rulings and blocks a stop that breaks one. Before an edit, the judge's first half: what governs this region. At a decision: a record where it will be found. At a new project: a spine before the first line. Across time: what changed in the law.
